description: Save significantly on costs, skip the red tape, and fast-forward to the fun part of building your dream Bay-view home! Minutes from the Golden Gate Bridge, 77 Crescent is a fully-entitled, actively under-construction 4BD/3.5BA elevator-served residence designed by sustainability expert Millard Arterberry. Nearly $1M in heavy site work, excavation, shoring, drainage, sewer, and partial foundation is already complete, and all coastal & building permits are in hand. Acquire the land, approvals, and improvements now, then finish off the construction with exactly the finishes you choose. This dramatic residence features a street-level 2-car garage + 1 off-street space; three bedrooms on the entry floor; dramatic living/kitchen/dining level opening through a bifold glass wall to an ~770sf deck with sweeping Bay vistas; top-floor primary retreat with spa bath, ~375sf private deck, and stairs to a living roof ready for sunset yoga or spa. Wake to shorebirds, bike the Marin Headlands before breakfast, reach SF in under 15 minutes. This is an incredible opportunity to realize your vision and build your dream home without most of the hassle!
